caveats.text: The PID set this node binds is GM's shared 'E39 4cyl LAF - 10 Equinox/Terrian' set, not an A20NFT set. Only 14 applicability rows in the whole database mention LHU, so the database cannot say which of these parameters the A20NFT actually answers. Every parameter is therefore marked applicability = UNVERIFIED, and NRC-31 on a real car is expected for a fair number of them.

test_binding is dead in this index: 0 of 467,860 rows resolve to a data list, data node or object, and func_name is empty in every row. There is no test -> frame and no test -> watch-list join anywhere. Pairing a test with a device control can only be done by name, and any such pairing is UNVERIFIED.
There are no security-access or seed/key rows for this ECM. security_block has no row tying to the E39A node, so nothing here unlocks a programming session.

There are no pass/fail thresholds. The lo/hi values in each conversion are the display limits GDS2 draws with, not a specification, and some are plainly wrong -- Brake Booster Pressure Sensor scales to kPa but carries hi = 1. Never treat a range in this pack as a pass/fail limit.
